SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_TASK_END_V2] @task_name [varchar](100),@pipeline_runid [VARCHAR](50),@data_layer [nvarchar](150),@status [VARCHAR](30), @tablename [VARCHAR](100) AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(MAX) = ('DECLARE @V_TGT_REC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0) SELECT @V_TGT_REC_CNT=COUNT(*) FROM '+@tablename+' WHERE H=''D''
		
	UPDATE [OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] 
	SET 
		STATUS_ID = (SELECT STATUS_ID FROM OM.OM_STATUS WHERE STATUS = UPPER('''+@status+''')), 
		END_DATETIME = CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Singapore Standard Time'' AS datetime),
		TGT_RECCOUNT = @V_TGT_REC_CNT
	WHERE 
		PIPELINE_RUNID = '''+@pipeline_runid+''' AND
		TASK_RUN_ID = concat('''+@pipeline_runid+''',''-'',UPPER('''+@task_name+''')) AND
		DATA_LAYER = '''+@data_layer+'''');
		
	EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
	--BEGIN

	 --  THROW 60000, @sql_code, 1;  
    --END
			   
END
GO
